# House Painters Denver CO

> A homeowner's guide to hiring a painter in Colorado, published by Painter Hotline (Denver-headquartered painting company; phone 720-208-5645; https://painterhotline.com/). Covers vetting (Colorado has no state painting license), sourced Denver cost ranges, Colorado lead (pre-1978, Regulation 19) and asbestos (32 sq ft) rules, winter painting temperature limits, testing colors at altitude, contracts, warranties, and a printable vetting checklist.

## Guide
- [How to Vet a House Painter in Colorado: The Homeowner's Guide](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/): Colorado doesn't license painters. A homeowner's guide to vetting one: insurance, itemized quotes, sourced Denver cost ranges, lead and asbestos rules, and a checklist.
- [Do Painters Need a License in Colorado? What to Verify Instead](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/do-painters-need-a-license-in-colorado/): Colorado has no state painting license. What 'licensed' usually means, and what to verify instead: insurance, warranty, lien waivers, references and RRP.
- [Denver Painting Quotes: Published Cost Ranges & How to Compare](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/painting-quotes-and-cost-ranges/): Published Denver painting cost ranges from Angi and Improovy, dated and explained, plus how to read and compare itemized painting quotes before you hire.
- [Colorado Painting Rules: Lead (Pre-1978) & Popcorn Ceiling Asbestos](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/colorado-painting-rules/): Colorado rules homeowners should know before painting: Regulation 19 lead-safe steps for pre-1978 homes and CDPHE's 32 sq ft asbestos inspection trigger.
- [Can You Paint in Winter in Colorado? Interior vs Exterior Limits](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/can-you-paint-in-winter-colorado/): Interior painting works all winter in Colorado. Exterior painting follows the product label: Duration Exterior down to 35°F, Aura Exterior 35–100°F.
- [Testing Paint Colors in Colorado Sun: A Sample Method That Works](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/testing-paint-colors-at-altitude/): Why colors look different at altitude (UV up ~2% per 1,000 ft) and a step-by-step way to test paint samples on your own Colorado house.
- [Printable Painter Vetting Checklist: Compare 3 Colorado Painters](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/painter-vetting-checklist/): Free printable checklist to compare up to three house painters: insurance, itemized quote, warranty, lien waivers, lead and asbestos rules, references.
- [Plan Spring Exterior Painting in Colorado: Book in Winter](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/plan-spring-exterior-painting/): When to book exterior painting in Colorado: quote and colors over winter, start date set by product temperature limits. Request a spring exterior estimate.
- [Homeowner Painting Guides: Contracts, Warranties & More](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/blog/): Plain-language guides for Colorado homeowners hiring a painter: what a contract should include and how to read a painting warranty.
- [What a Painting Contract Should Include (Colorado Homeowner Guide)](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/blog/what-a-painting-contract-should-include/): A line-by-line painting contract checklist for Colorado homeowners: scope, prep, products, coats, payments, change orders, lien waivers (C.R.S. 38-22) and warranty.
- [How to Read a Painting Warranty: What Is Actually Covered](https://housepaintersdenverco.com/blog/how-to-read-a-painting-warranty/): Workmanship vs product warranties, the exclusions to look for, transferability and how claims should work, explained for Colorado homeowners.

## Key facts (with sources on each page)
- Colorado has no statewide painting-contractor credential (contractorlicenserequirements.com, updated Oct 26 2026).
- Pre-1978 housing: Regulation 19 pre-renovation education when 2+ sq ft of painted surface is disturbed; Renovate Right pamphlet at least 7 days before work (CDPHE).
- Single-family asbestos inspection trigger: >32 sq ft, 50 linear ft of pipe, or 55-gal drum volume (CDPHE); possible exemption for buildings after Oct 12 1988.
- Sherwin-Williams Duration Exterior applies down to 35°F; Benjamin Moore Aura Exterior 35–100°F.
- Colorado mechanics liens: generally file within 4 months; notice of intent 10 days before filing (C.R.S. 38-22-109, via Levelset).
